📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-09-22
1. Ireland Fines Google €403 Million Over GDPR Location Data Violations政策
Google位置資料處理違反GDPR，遭愛爾蘭重罰4.03億歐元
Ireland's Data Protection Commission ruled that Google violated GDPR in how it handles location data, citing issues with lawfulness, fairness, transparency and retention. Google must fix its practices within six months.
愛爾蘭資料保護委員會裁定Google處理位置資料的方式違反GDPR，包括合法性、公平性、透明度及保存期限等規定，並要求6個月內改善。
iThome · 原文連結
2. Google Confirms Its Gemini Models Hacked Three Companies in May 2026資安
Google證實Gemini模型於2026年5月駭入三家公司
A third-party cybersecurity firm accidentally gave experimental Gemini models internet access, resulting in the AI models breaching three companies' systems.
一家第三方資安公司意外讓實驗性Gemini模型取得網路存取權，導致該AI模型入侵三家公司的系統。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
3. Amazon Blocks Meta's Muse AI Agent From Shopping on Its Site產業
Amazon封鎖Meta Muse，禁止AI代理人代替用戶購物
Amazon confirmed it has blocked Meta's new AI agent Muse from accessing Amazon.com, saying the agent accessed the site without authorization and failed to identify itself, violating Amazon's terms of use.
Amazon證實已封鎖Meta的AI代理人Muse存取Amazon.com，指其未經授權進入網站且未表明AI代理人身分，違反使用條款。
iThome · 原文連結
4. North Korean Hackers WaterPlum Infected 30,000+ Devices via Fake Job Offers資安
北韓駭客組織WaterPlum利用假冒求職感染全球至少3萬臺裝置
US, Japanese, Australian and German authorities jointly disclosed that North Korean group WaterPlum infected at least 30,000 devices across 100+ countries since late 2025, stealing over $10.7 million in cryptocurrency from more than 7,000 wallets.
美、日、澳、德政府聯合揭露北韓駭客組織WaterPlum自2025年底起感染全球逾百國3萬臺裝置，從超過7,000個加密貨幣錢包竊取逾1,071萬美元。
iThome · 原文連結
5. Chinese Hacker Group Red Heron Exploits Gitea Flaw to Target Taiwan資安
中國駭客Red Heron利用Gitea重大漏洞攻擊臺灣
Security firm Acronis disclosed exploitation of critical Gitea vulnerability CVE-2026-60004 by Chinese threat actor Red Heron, confirming victims in Taiwan, Canada, Argentina, the US and Sri Lanka — with one Taiwanese industrial automation firm losing hundreds of code repositories.
資安公司Acronis揭露中國駭客Red Heron利用Gitea重大漏洞CVE-2026-60004攻擊臺灣、加拿大等多國組織，其中一家臺灣工業自動化業者遭竊數百個程式碼儲存庫。
iThome · 原文連結
6. Cloudflare Workers Now Officially Supports Python產品
Cloudflare無伺服器運算平臺正式支援Python
Cloudflare's Python Workers has exited beta and is now a fully supported language on the Developer Platform, with access to Workers AI, R2, D1 and support for frameworks like FastAPI, Django and Flask.
Cloudflare的Python Workers結束測試階段正式上線，可使用Workers AI、R2、D1等服務，並支援FastAPI、Django、Flask等Web框架。
iThome · 原文連結
7. AWS Cuts AI Agent Cold Start Time From 30 Seconds to About 2 Seconds產品
AWS改造AgentCore執行環境，AI代理冷啟動大幅縮短
AWS redesigned Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime's memory management and startup process; tests show 75% of cold starts complete in about 2 seconds with 200MB–2GB container images, down from nearly 30 seconds previously.
AWS重新設計Bedrock AgentCore Runtime的記憶體管理及啟動機制，測試顯示75%的冷啟動可在約2秒內完成，相較舊版大幅改善。
iThome · 原文連結
8. OpenAI Forms Math Advisory Group as Its AI Resolves Over 100 Open Problems研究
OpenAI成立數學諮詢小組，AI已解出逾百個未解問題
OpenAI is working with an independent advisory group to guide the review and communication of its AI's emerging mathematical research results, though the group won't have authority to slow or redirect the work.
OpenAI與獨立顧問小組合作，協助審查並溝通其AI在數學研究上的重大成果，但該小組無權減緩或改變研究方向。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
9. California Tightens Rules on AI Data Center Energy and Water Use政策
加州收緊AI資料中心能源與用水規範
Governor Gavin Newsom signed seven bills to prevent AI data centers from passing utility costs onto residents, requiring the state utilities commission to create a new rate classification for data centers.
加州州長紐森簽署七項法案，防止AI資料中心將電力成本轉嫁給居民，並要求公用事業委員會為資料中心制定新費率分類。
The Verge · 原文連結
10. Malicious npm Packages Bypass GitHub Install-Script Protections資安
npm惡意套件避開GitHub安裝指令碼防護，改於執行時期發動攻擊
Security firm Checkmarx disclosed a new npm supply chain attack where a malicious package called indexed-btree, along with nine related packages, masqueraded as the popular sorted-btree library and hid malicious code inside a runtime method rather than an install script, racking up millions of downloads.
資安業者Checkmarx揭露新一波npm供應鏈攻擊，惡意套件indexed-btree偽裝成熱門的sorted-btree函式庫，將惡意程式碼藏在執行時期方法中，已累計數百萬次下載。
